dataset_name: Material Property & Constitutive Model Dataset for SOFC FEM
description: Complete material property and constitutive model dataset for Finite Element Analysis of Solid Oxide Fuel Cells
based_on_research: A Closed-Loop, Microstructure-Informed DIC-FEM Framework for the Real-Time Mitigation of Sintering Stresses in Solid Oxide Fuel Cells through Targeted Creep Activation

thermal_properties.description: Thermo-physical properties including green state properties, sintering kinetics (dilatometry), and coefficient of thermal expansion

creep_data.description: Viscoplastic (creep) constitutive data with Norton's law parameters (A, n, Q) for green and sintering states

elastic_properties.description: Elastic properties (Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio) as functions of temperature and relative density

elastic.description: Linear elastic with temperature-dependent Young's modulus

validation.verification_status: Cross-referenced with published SOFC material data

compatible_software: Any FEA software accepting material property inputs
